question: What enduring quality makes this practice beloved to the yoginīs?
premises: The practice possesses splendor equal to the rising sun
This splendor is described as eternal
The practice is dear to the yoginīs
inference: An eternally radiant quality renders the practice beloved to the yoginīs
uncertainties: The exact referent of the described practice is implicit from context
plain_english: It is eternally radiant like the rising sun and indeed dear to the yoginīs.
